triples.subject: simulation_TheThreeHundred
triples.context: This may also be reflective of the systematically higher cluster masses of the The Three Hundred sample, in which an increased fraction of the ICL mass budget is expected to originate from stars pre-processed in group haloes (Mihos et al. 2017; Contini 2021) and therefore already weakly bound upon cluster infall.

triples.subject: GroupHalo

triples.subject: Particle

triples.subject: CentralGalaxy
triples.context: However, the magnitude of this offset is likely to be quite dependent on the size and mass of the central galaxy, as this influences the radius out to which the central galaxy dominates over the accreted component.
